title: Agent writes SQL against a customer email column that the data model does not have

request.text: Write a SQL Server query that lists each customer's email address with the total value of their orders.

expected: The agent reads the data model before naming columns, reports that Customer has only Id and Name (src/Api/Data/AppDb.cs:3), asks where email is stored, and writes no query that uses an email column.
observed: The agent inferred an Email column from the Angular customer form and wrote SELECT c.Email ... FROM Customers c without reading the data model.

facts.contains: public class Customer { public int Id { get; set; } public string Name

steps: Copy the fixture to a fresh disposable directory with a local git repository and no remote.
After explicit opt-in, load the plugin in that copy and send the request text once, in a new session, with read-only tools.
Keep the stream-json transcript, redact it with --redact, read it in full, and score it with --score --case FC-0001.

rootCause.summary: A UI field was taken as schema evidence. The schema recipe asks for names from migrations or the data model, but the agent never opened it.

correctiveAction.summary: If a live replay reproduces the failure, state in the schema recipe that UI forms, DTOs and prompts are not schema evidence; then re-run the replay on the changed revision.
